tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha khang chen mor mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gyis sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can gyi 'khrungs rab bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bzhugs// oṃ grub par gyur cig bde chen rtse lnga'i ri bo'i pho brang nas/ /'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅges 'gro don phyir/ /'phags pa'i yul dang bod 'dir mkhas grub kyi/ /skyes chen du mar sprul tshul 'di ltar te/ 1 /mo'u 'gal bu dang shrī singha'i mtshan/ /zhi ba 'tsho dang mi thub zla ba sogs/ /paṇ+ḍi ta yi skye ba bcu gcig brgyud/ /sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros la sogs pa/ 2 /paṇa grub gcig gis lhag pa'i lnga phrag tu/ /sprul nas 'phags yul 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad/ /bod 'dir chos blon mgar ba stong btsan dang / /sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms lo tsā ba/ 3 /lcog ro klu rgyal gyi jo zla 'od dang / /khyad par sa skya'i dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan mched du legs sprul nas/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ 4 /phyi dus 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /theg chen chos rje kun mkhyen go ram che/ /klong chen rab 'byams rje btsun gong dkar ba/ /kun dga' rnam rgyal zhabs dang thams cad mkhyen/ 5 /mang du thos pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho rje 'di dang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho thugs rgyud gcig par yang mi 'gal lam snyam mo/ /zhes/ /sa skya'i yab chos rgyud gsum man ngag gam/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog tu sprul mdzad nas/ /de nyid sa skya'i bstan 'dzin sa skya pa'i/ 6 /gdung rigs nang nas gdung rigs kun gyi rgyan/ /kun dga' rin chen dang mtshungs kun dga'i mtshan/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan mkhas pa'i rje 'dir sprul/ /de lta'i 'brel tshad don ldan skyes chen gyi/ 7 /'khrungs rabs logs bris mthong ba don ldan 'di/ /'dzam gling per thogs rgyal po bon gong pa/ /shes rab 'byung gnas grags pa rin chen sogs/

/mched grogs lnga yis sor rtse'i 'phrul las bskrun/ 8 /'di yi sbyin bdag sngags 'chang bla ma yi/ /zhabs 'bring go re len gyi mchod g.yog ni/ /rang lo nyer gsum lon pa nas brtsams te/ /bgyis pa'i skal ba mchog dang ldan pa yi/ 9 /shākya'i dge slong smon lam rin chen gyis/ /zhe brgyad lon pa lcags mo yos kyi lo/ /mi phyed dad pas kun nas bslangs te bsgrubs/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ 10 /rtsa ba'i bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan nas/ /sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / /bdag kyang sngar bzhin nad med tshe ring zhing / /zhabs 'bring zhabs tog bya ba mthar phyin shog 11 /mdor na deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /sngags 'chang bla ma nyid dang mi 'bral zhing / /dag pa'i zhing skyes sa lam myur bsgrod nas/ /sprul pas bla ma'i 'phrin las rgyas byed shog 12 /bla ma kun 'dus kun dga' bsod nams dang / /yi dam kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /chos skyong kun 'dus pu tra chen po yis/ /don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis bdag la stsol/ /nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ /bhu su ku yi rnal 'byor pa/ /gdod nas rang grol de yis smras/ 14 /ka l+ya na war+dhan+tu/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ lha khang chen mor sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can gyi 'khrungs rabs bzhengs pa'i dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
